[News] Raontech and SN Display Collaborate on Perovskite-Based MicroLED Microdisplays
item.description: Korea's Raontech announced that it has signed an MoU with SN Display to co-develop perovskite-based next-generation AR/VR displays. The two companies are already conducting preliminary research in which SN Display's perovskite technology is applied to Raontech's microLED microdisplay samples, in order to verify the performance improvements and potential applications of next-generation microdisplays.
